items.title: Develop Mini Task Manager Application
items.snippet:
Develop Mini Task Manager Application
**Project Objective**

Develop a functional Mini Task Manager web application using an automated multi-agent software development workflow.

**Technology Stack**
...

knowledge.scope: native visibility/version before retrieval + fresh native ACL/version after retrieval

ba.summary: Bo sung tinh nang phan loai cong viec theo danh muc va xuat CSV bao cao tien do tu dong cho Mini Task Manager dua tren phan hoi nguoi dung.
scope: Them truong danh muc (category) vao model du lieu va co so du lieu SQLite.
Ho tro loc va quan ly cong viec theo danh muc tren API va giao dien web.
Trien khai endpoint xuat bao cao tien do cong viec duoi dang file CSV.
api_behavior: POST /tasks chap nhan them truong category tuy chon khi tao cong viec.
PATCH /tasks/{id} ho tro cap nhat truong category cua cong viec.
GET /tasks ho tro tham so loc theo category. GET /tasks/export/csv tra ve tep CSV chua danh sach va thong ke tien do.
edge_cases: Truong category trong hoac chua ky tu dac biet duoc xuat va luu tru an toan tranh loi SQL Injection hoac loi CSV parsing.
Yeu cau xuat CSV khi danh sach cong viec trong tra ve tep CSV chi co dong tieu de.
acceptance: AC10: POST va PATCH ho tro luu tru, tra ve chinh xac truong category.
AC11: GET /tasks?category=... loc dung danh sach theo danh muc.
AC12: GET /tasks/export/csv tra ve HTTP 200, dinh dang MIME text/csv kem noi dung dung chuan.
limitations: Khong ho tro quan ly bang danh muc rieng biet phuc tap.
Xuat CSV ho tro dinh dang tieu chuẩnUTF-8 va phan tach dau phay.
